newsitem.title: FRANCE: NatWest Sellier cuts Sanofi to "lighten".
newsitem.headline: NatWest Sellier cuts Sanofi to "lighten".

text.p: PARIS, 22 May, Reuter - Stockbroker NatWest Sellier has cut its recommendation for French drugs group Sanofi to "lighten" from "hold", fund managers said on Thursday.
At 1356 GMT Sanofi shares were down 2.83 percent at 549 francs while the CAC-40 index of blue chip stocks was down 1.28 percent.
One fund manager said NatWest thought Sanofi would be too vulnerable to government restrictions in health spending which accounted for 30 percent of group sales in 1996.
